business_problem: In winter, demand surges—up to 10 times higher—resulted in system lags and long customer wait times at registers. To address these challenges and reduce technical debt and total cost of ownership, Chicks set its sights on cloud migration. To improve reliability and scalability during peak shopping periods, the company chose to migrate to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
solution_summary: Chicks Lifestyle (Chicks) is a heritage clothing retailer in Hong Kong specializing in thermal and innerwear. To improve reliability and scalability during peak shopping periods, the company chose to migrate to Amazon Web Services (AWS). The migration, completed in just six weeks with no data loss for critical SAP and POS systems, was a seamless process.
